newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia govt to help in banking mergers - Anwar.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia govt to help in banking mergers - Anwar.

text.p: The Malaysian government will help in the merger of banks to strengthen the domestic financial system, Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Anwar Ibrahim said on Monday.

"The decision to encourage the merger of smaller local financial institutions is to strengthen the financial system in Malaysia. Our aim is to make them into a meaningful and significant institutions in order to compete effectively and to serve the needs of the country and market," he said in a speech at the launch of Sime Bank Bhd.
"We must accept the fact that there are domestic institutions that do not have the size, but have the determination and desire to play a bigger role," he said.

The central bank, Bank Negara, has been quietly pushing for the mergers of the country's financial institutions as Malaysia will eventually have to open up its market to foreign competition by early 2000.
Anwar said the larger financial institutions must also seriously consider the option of mergers as "the playing field may not be as flat as we want".
